title: Conformance script: wasm export of every example compared with the CLI export
description:
scripts/daw-export-parity.mjs runs the wasm export (Node WASI, as the dsp tests do) on every examples/*.apr and .yaml, runs `apricity export --daw-set` on the same, and diffs the set files; then runs the set checker from M5's scripts/daw-export-smoke.sh on each. Wire it into CI's wasm job.

Verification: the script exits 0 on develop; a deliberately changed template makes it fail.
